phaseClock: Actual pinned canonical simulation clocks minus its observed first-step ignition; unchanged contact source clock chooses adjacent30Hz samples. Native phase is NOT a cache frame.
interpolation: Raw f32 inputs, JavaScript-double temporal interpolation at exact measured voxel centres. GPU uniform mix is separately recorded; these scientific values are not a GPU readback.
plotting: Self-contained fixed-scale SVG; linear color quantization is display only. No source threshold, optical transfer, mask or smoothing. Temperature is an uncalibrated solver proxy, not kelvin.
